items.text: Before the quotes of each round, the market makers can talk in a chat. Each market maker may send up to 7 messages per round, of up to 150 words each; a longer message is cut at 150 words. Market makers speak in turn. The conversation ends when everyone has said "done" or the limit is reached. After saying "done", you send no more messages that round. {{TALK_NOTICE}}
